resources.string: BookKaro open nahi ho pa raha. Internet check karke dobara try kijiye — aapka review safe hai.
IRCTC open nahi ho pa raha. Please try again.
IRCTC handoff nahi mila ya khatam ho gaya. BookKaro mein review check karke \"Continue to IRCTC\" dobara dabaiye.
Is phone ka Android System WebView purana hai, isliye IRCTC autofill surakshit tareeke se nahi chal sakta. Play Store se \"Android System WebView\" update kijiye.
Ye approved IRCTC page nahi hai — BookKaro yahan kuch fill nahi karega.
